This graph shows the annual average air temperature across the contiguous 48 states relative to the historical 100-year average (1901 through 2000). Historical observations are from 1901 through 2023. Modeled projections for four different climate scenarios run from 2015 through 2100. Historical model outputs are shown from 1950 to 2014. Modeled outputs are smoothed using an 11-year moving average. Shaded bands show the range of unsmoothed annual values from different climate models. Select items in the legend to toggle them on or off.
